services.name: Charters departing before 5pm
services.desc: Whether it’s a high seas adventure or a relaxing trip around Baltimore's Inner Harbor, we have the pirate voyage for you! No matter the event, our jolly crew will ‘pirate up your party’ with fun games, activities, and entertainment. Rates are for regularly scheduled one hour sailings before 5pm. Full Boat Charters can be booked 7 days a week. All Cruises include 30 minutes of boarding activities before sailing. Prices do not include 10% Baltimore A&A Tax. A 50% deposit is due at the time of booking. Call for more information. Check for available dates
